g.text: Behavior and search work: paired changes, separately from cost

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #25313c

g.text: All 32 exact action sequences changed. Family changes, distinct regions, duplicate schedules and work counts are different measurements.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #25313c

g.text: Signed values are treatment − control; color intensity is scaled separately in each metric panel. Y / N compares exact actions, then coarse action families.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #25313c

g.text: Regions use exact method + normalized knobs. Duplicates use commutative parent-index schedules, preserving row order/multiplicity/output. † Censored prefix pair.
